text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of two years of the 
U.A.F.— The Finals are finally about to 
begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public was in a frenzy, eagerly 
awaiting the birth of the No. 1 Athlete 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The passion of the competing Umamusume and 
the grandeur of the fans' expectations 
rival any race— Now, onward to the 
pinnacle of athlete Umamusume!
